_comment: Committed content for the tradeoff family (B-21 S1c, W1.3): a numbered precedence policy where several rules trigger and ONLY the highest-ranked applies - the bench 'tradeoff' shape. The builder draws the arity first (2..20 candidate actions including never-winning distractors and the no-rule default), draws the winning rule first and decomposes the triggers around it (L-010 - never a rank prior), permutes the option order, and derives the label from the tree (ADR-0014/15). Rule themes are paired with their trigger wording; actions/targets are drawn from the pools.
question: Apply policy {code} to ticket {ref} and choose the single action the agent must take now.
precedence_blurb: Precedence. When more than one rule below applies to a ticket, the agent performs ONLY the action of the highest-ranked applicable rule now. Lower-ranked requests are noted on the ticket and handled after the higher-ranked item is closed.
noise_line: The customer's message also asks for {noise}.
default_rule: If no rule above applies, the ticket is handled by the standard flow (Action: {action}).
